name: busy-yonge-street-level
js: (async () => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); if (!document.body.classList.contains('hud-minimized')) document.getElementById('btn-toggle-hud')?.click(); app.teleportTo(330, -1000, 0); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [330, 2, -1000], look: [330, 2, -1000 + 50], fov: 55 }); await sleep(10000); const TS = app.trafficSystem; let best = null, score = -1; for (const c of TS.cars) { if (!c.edge || Math.hypot(c.x - 330, c.z - (-1000)) > 150) continue; const s = Math.sin(c.yaw), k = Math.cos(c.yaw); let n = 0; for (const d of TS.cars) { if (!d.edge || d === c) continue; const f = (d.x - c.x) * s + (d.z - c.z) * k, l = Math.abs((d.x - c.x) * k - (d.z - c.z) * s); if (f > 0 && f < 45 && l < 8) n++; } if (n > score) { score = n; best = c; } } if (!best) { console.log('[vehicles] busy-yonge: no cars'); return; } const s = Math.sin(best.yaw), k = Math.cos(best.yaw), y = best.y || 0; const pos = [best.x - s * 10 + k * 2.6, y + 1.6, best.z - k * 10 - s * 2.6], look = [best.x + s * 45, y + 1.0, best.z + k * 45]; app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos, look, fov: 55 }); console.log('[vehicles] busy-yonge: ' + score + ' cars ahead of the camera at ' + pos.map((v) => v.toFixed(0)).join(',')); await sleep(1200); { const TS = app.trafficSystem; const kinds = {}; let placed = 0; for (const c of TS.cars) { if (!c.edge) continue; placed++; kinds[c.bodyType] = (kinds[c.bodyType] || 0) + 1; } const acc = { bodyDraws: 0, bodyShadowDraws: 0, bodyTris: 0, bodyInstances: 0, wheelDraws: 0, wheelTris: 0 }; TS.group.traverse((o) => { if (!o.isInstancedMesh || !o.visible || !o.count) return; const a = o.geometry.attributes; const t = (o.geometry.index ? o.geometry.index.count : a.position.count) / 3 * o.count; if (a.carState) { acc.bodyDraws++; if (o.castShadow) acc.bodyShadowDraws++; acc.bodyTris += t; acc.bodyInstances += o.count; } else if (a.wheelStyle) { acc.wheelDraws++; acc.wheelTris += t; } }); acc.bodyTris = Math.round(acc.bodyTris); acc.wheelTris = Math.round(acc.wheelTris); const info = app.renderer.info.render; console.log('[vehicles] busy-yonge ' + JSON.stringify({ tier: C.QUALITY.tier, placed, kinds, ...acc, frameDraws: info.drawCalls, frameTris: info.triangles })); } })()
